profile.name: Lidia
profile.overview: Lidia Sobieska, the Polish prime minister, fights with traditional karate. Wavu Wiki highlights her punishment: she has a punisher for almost every frame window. Her best mix-ups are launch punishable on a wrong guess, and her stance transitions are a required part of her game.
profile.playstyle: Precise punishment and stance flow. Punish everything with the right tool, keep pressure with plus moves (df+4~3, f,f,F+1, qcf+4) and flow between Horse (HRS), Cat (CAT) and Wolf (WLF) stances. Her mix-ups commit hard, so pick your moments. In Heat she gains Heaven and Earth (HAE).
strengths: Politically Punishing. Having punishers for almost every frame advantage and situation, Lidia rewards precisely punishing the opposition's poor preference for improperly placed pokes.
Tenacious Tactics. Stance situations are quickly and easily enforced and can't be escaped.
Runaway Freight Train. Can win rounds clean in under 10 seconds, even against strong defense.
Blue Spark Queen. Has the highest number of blue spark inputs in the game.
Reversal Toolbox. With a strong powercrush and two varieties of parry, Lidia has many options to struggle out of sticky situations.
weaknesses: High Commitment. Her best mixup options are all launchable on a wrong guess. Stance transitions are not optional.
Slow Starter. Needs to build up HAE stacks to truly take off. Losing early rounds without getting any stacks makes it difficult to mount a comeback.
One-Track Mind. The good moves are good. Your opponents' round and fleshy bodies may start looking a lot like nails for your f,F+2's hammer.
Low Reward CHs. Her counter hit options mostly give a single free hit. The best counter hit launchers are either unsafe or heavily scaled.

stances.name: Cat

stances.note: Wavu mini-combo: counter-hit df+2 into CAT.3.

stances.name: Wolf
stances.entry: qcf+1+2,2 on hit or block, HRS.1
stances.note: Another stance in her flow; check the Move Library for its moves.

heat: Enhanced f,F+2 – reversal break, CH property on normal hit

keyMoves.summary: Coiled Elbow Slam: i15 mid, +0 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid that can transition to stance.

keyMoves.summary: Swift High Seikenzuki: i13 high from a run, +6 on block, tornadoes on hit.
keyMoves.use: To close distance and keep the turn.

keyMoves.summary: Cleaving Spirit: i15 launcher, -5 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Her i15 launch punisher, safe on block.

keyMoves.summary: Gankaku: i15 punish string (Wavu: s-15), tornadoes on hit.
Upward Thrust: i15 while-standing tornado, -12 on block.
Bridging the Gap: i14 while-standing knee, -12 on block.
Flash Elbow: i12 Heat Engager from crouch, -14 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A fast crouch punish that starts Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Back Spin Kick: i16 homing high, -3 on block, launches on counter hit (+31a).
Lame Duck: i18 low, -14 on block.
Adjourning Sweep: i16 homing low, -11 on block, can transition to stance.
Stalwart Governance: i18 mid Heat Engager, +2 on block.
